scope_decision.bounded_package_receipt: The six-file DELIVERED_FILES manifest closes GOAL-V330-DELIVERED only.
scope_decision.fleet_migration: Converge version pins and applicable credited executable behavior through the semantic rows below.
scope_decision.rejected_shortcut: Do not report full v3.30 convergence from the six-file bounded package or from version strings alone.
scope_decision.rejected_overreach: Do not copy all 38 tag-delta files indiscriminately; release-only and repository-specific artifacts are not automatically instance-applicable.

target_denominator.derivation_time: immediately before wave planning and again at final reconciliation

semantic_rows.preserve: all instance-owned identity, history, extension, governance, and local configuration fields
receipt: values persist in a fresh process or post-restart verification

semantic_rows.applies_to: every in-scope AGET fleet seat that owns scripts/study_topic.py
semantic_rows.outcome: study_topic reaches canonical spec and pattern tiers when available and reports them UNAVAILABLE rather than manufacturing coverage when absent
receipt: destination script digest matches the declared v3.30.0 digest
focused tests pass on the executed destination surface
a fresh-process study reports a canonical path or explicit UNAVAILABLE state

semantic_rows.applies_to: in-scope AGET repositories whose selected client consumes the bounded Agent Skills package
semantic_rows.outcome: the corrected bounded package is digest-addressed, conformant, manually copied with a destination postcondition, and invoked with its AGET runtime dependencies satisfied
required_receiver_paths: scripts/wake_up.py for the wake-up script path or the documented AGET fallback substrate
planning/ and sessions/ where the selected skill uses them
v_tests: destination SKILL.md digest equals the selected manifest row
one applicable packaged skill invokes successfully from the destination AGET repository
the receipt names whether the script path or fallback path executed

excluded_from_automatic_instance_copy: release notes, handoffs, release plans, and publication telemetry unless the target archetype owns them
tests not needed at runtime after their migration receipt is recorded
any tag-delta file not selected by an applicable semantic row
wave_preconditions: gmelli/aget-aget#2191 public fix-forward is present on the selected source ref
the supervisor has created a governed wave plan with success criteria and rollback
the authoritative fleet register and target denominator are recorded
a pilot seat passes every applicable semantic row before the next cohort

per_seat_required: applied payload with source and destination digests
rollback result if any row fails
success_prohibited_if: study_topic.py remains at the v3.29.0 blob
a packaged-skill runtime prerequisite is missing
the destination copy or digest was not verified

authorization.framework_lane: defines public contract and verifies evidence
authorization.supervisor_lane: creates wave plan, dispatches, mutates fleet, and supplies receipts
authorization.current_decision: HOLD; this artifact does not authorize dispatch or cross-fleet writes

rollback: Restore the prior per-seat version pins and only the semantic-row payloads changed by the wave; preserve instance-owned state and record the failed row.
